answers.reason: The senate is a central university body chaired by the president, not a faculty body where the student representative takes part.
The budget planning round is handled by university leadership and administration, not the student representative's specific body.
Appointment committees deal with professorship appointments, which are outside the scope of the student representative's body.
The faculty council decides on the affairs of the faculty where the elected student representative speaks for the students.
Study commissions deal with degree programmes and teaching, falling under faculty matters where students participate.
The examination board decides on individual student examination matters, not general faculty representation bodies.
Internal research funding rounds award research grants, which do not concern the student representative's mandate.
Module revision working groups rewrite degree programme descriptions, relating to study matters within the faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a specific administrative or technical task, not the student representative's decision body.
Orientation week planning concerns student programs, which involves student representation.
